items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: Marie MacDonald was on another show.

ctx.x: as far as the eye specialist. Here comes the sargeant up to me. He said, 'Let me see your papers.' He took my papers. He said, 'Follow me.' He brought me to the Major's office and he says sit there. He goes, and about a half hour later, he comes out and gave me a slip. He said, 'Go back to your band.' He said, 'We'll see you when you come back.'

So, I've been doing all this for the service. I don't know if that's got anything to do with it or not. So, I goes back to the band. I'm out there for 8 weeks at this club. At NBC, I was doing recordings, tapes, recordings for overseas. They'd have a guest artist from the movies, like Jack Benny was on my show one time. Marie MacDonald was on another show. You know, every Monday, I had Monday off. And, I was doing that.
So, when I finished that 8 weeks, I figured I go get back to New York. I went back to New York a week. Here come my papers again. Here come my papers again. So, I go on back. I goes down and
